name: Marilith

actions.name: Six-Sword Flurry
actions.effect: The Marilith attacks with all six swords in a whirlwind. Can target up to 3 different creatures within reach, dividing the damage dice as desired.

actions.name: Tail Constrict
actions.effect: Target is grappled and restrained by the Marilith's serpentine tail. Restrained creatures take 2d10 bludgeoning at the start of each of the Marilith's turns.

reactions.name: Reactive Parry
reactions.effect: The Marilith uses one of its six swords to parry. +6 to physical defense against one melee attack.

reactions.name: Reactive Strike
reactions.effect: When a creature within reach attacks an ally, the Marilith makes a Longsword Strike against the attacker.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: +2d6 to saves against spells and magical effects.

traits.name: Tactical Genius
traits.desc: All demon allies within 18m gain +1d6 to attack rolls. The Marilith can telepathically coordinate its allies.

traits.name: Six Arms
traits.desc: The Marilith wields six longswords simultaneously. It cannot be disarmed while it has at least one sword remaining.

lore: Mariliths are the supreme generals of demonic armies: six-armed serpent-women of unmatched martial skill. They combine superhuman swordsmanship with tactical brilliance, coordinating vast demonic hordes with deadly efficiency. Even demon lords treat them with respect.
